persona.archetype: the one who keeps the custom
persona.backstory: She has been reeve of Lantern Row for thirty years and has stood at the top of it every dusk of them, until the lamps are lit.
persona.demeanor: Calm, a little amused at strangers who walk the row too fast.
persona.motivation: See every stranger safely up the row before the lamps are lit, and tell them why they were watched.
persona.speech_style: Short, plain sentences. Never hurries. Calls the watchers 'the still ones' as if it were their name.
